import math

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

int index_of(const string[] values, string target)
    for index := values.indices()[]
        if values[index] == target
            return int(index)
    return -1

bool includes(const int[] values, int target)
    for value := values[]
        if value == target
            return true
    return false

int position_of(const int[] values, int target)
    for index := values.indices()[]
        if values[index] == target
            return int(index)
    return -1

int | error number_word(string text)
    if #text > 10 or (#text > 1 and text[0] == "0")
        return error("bad arguments")
    for point := text.codepoints()[]
        if point < 48 or point > 57
            return error("bad arguments")
    return int(text)

string fraction(int numerator, int denominator)
    left := numerator
    right := denominator
    while right != 0
        left, right = right, left % right
    return "{numerator / left}/{denominator / left}"

class Move(string kind, int cell)
class UndoRecord(string kind, bool[] revealed, int[] marks, Move[] moves)

class Board(int width, int height, int mine_count, int seed)
    placed := false
    mines := array(nat(width * height), fill = false)
    numbers := array(nat(width * height), fill = 0)
    revealed := array(nat(width * height), fill = false)
    marks := array(nat(width * height), fill = 0)
    int[][] neighbors := []
    state := "ready"
    exploded := -1
    Move[] moves := []
    UndoRecord[] undos := []

Board new_board(int width, int height, int mine_count, int seed)
    board := Board(width, height, mine_count, seed)
    for: 0 <= row < height
        for: 0 <= column < width
            int[] neighbors := []
            for: -1 <= dy <= 1
                for: -1 <= dx <= 1
                    x := column + dx
                    y := row + dy
                    if (dx != 0 or dy != 0) and 0 <= x < width and 0 <= y < height
                        neighbors = neighbors.append(x + width * y)
            board.neighbors = board.neighbors.append(neighbors)
    return board

string cell_text(const Board board, int cell)
    return "{cell % board.width},{cell / board.width}"

string size_text(const Board board)
    return "{board.width}x{board.height}"

int remaining_mines(const Board board)
    return board.mine_count - int(#[for mark := board.marks[] if mark == 1 then mark])

int revealed_count(const Board board)
    return int(#[for open := board.revealed[] if open then open])

int safe_count(const Board board)
    return board.width * board.height - board.mine_count

bool is_unknown(const Board board, int cell)
    return not board.revealed[cell] and board.marks[cell] != 1

int[] unknown_cells(const Board board)
    return [for cell := board.revealed.indices()[] if is_unknown(board, int(cell)) then int(cell)]

bool finished(const Board board)
    return board.state == "won" or board.state == "lost"

void compute_numbers(Board &board)
    for cell := board.numbers.indices()[]
        board.numbers[cell] = int(#[for neighbor := board.neighbors[cell][] if board.mines[neighbor] then neighbor])

void place_mines(Board &board, int first, string safety)
    x := first % board.width
    y := first / board.width
    int[] choices := []
    for: 0 <= cell < board.width * board.height
        allowed := safety == "none" or (safety == "cell" and cell != first)
        if safety == "block"
            allowed = math.abs(cell % board.width - x) >= 2 or math.abs(cell / board.width - y) >= 2
        if allowed
            choices = choices.append(cell)
    generator := board.seed
    for: 0 <= placed < board.mine_count
        generator = 48271 * generator % 2147483647
        index := generator % int(#choices)
        board.mines[choices[index]] = true
        choices = choices[0:<index].concat(choices[index + 1:])
    compute_numbers(&board)
    board.placed = true
    board.state = "playing"

void reset_board(Board &board)
    board.revealed = array(nat(board.width * board.height), fill = false)
    board.marks = array(nat(board.width * board.height), fill = 0)
    board.moves = []
    board.undos = []
    board.exploded = -1
    board.state = if board.placed then "playing" else "ready"

int reveal_cell(Board &board, int cell, string safety)
    if not board.placed
        place_mines(&board, cell, safety)
    if board.mines[cell]
        board.state = "lost"
        board.exploded = cell
        return 0
    board.revealed[cell] = true
    board.marks[cell] = 0
    queue := [cell]
    nat head := 0
    while head < #queue
        current := queue[head]
        head += 1
        if board.numbers[current] == 0
            for neighbor := board.neighbors[current][]
                if is_unknown(board, neighbor)
                    board.revealed[neighbor] = true
                    board.marks[neighbor] = 0
                    queue = queue.append(neighbor)
    return int(#queue)

int chord_cells(Board &board, int cell, string safety)
    opened := 0
    for neighbor := board.neighbors[cell][]
        if is_unknown(board, neighbor)
            opened += reveal_cell(&board, neighbor, safety)
            if board.state == "lost"
                break
    return opened

void win_check(Board &board)
    if board.state == "playing" and revealed_count(board) == safe_count(board)
        board.state = "won"
        for cell := board.mines.indices()[]
            if board.mines[cell]
                board.marks[cell] = 1

void show_board(const Board board)
    hidden := ["#", "F", "?"]
    for: 0 <= row < board.height
        text := ""
        for: 0 <= column < board.width
            cell := column + row * board.width
            symbol := hidden[board.marks[cell]]
            if board.state == "lost" and board.mines[cell]
                symbol = if cell == board.exploded then "!" elif board.marks[cell] == 1 then "F" else "*"
            elif board.state == "lost" and board.marks[cell] == 1
                symbol = "X"
            elif board.revealed[cell]
                symbol = if board.numbers[cell] == 0 then "." else "{board.numbers[cell]}"
            text += symbol
        emit(text)

void finish_output(const Board board)
    if board.state == "lost"
        emit("boom {cell_text(board, board.exploded)}")
        show_board(board)
    elif board.state == "won"
        emit("win moves {#board.moves}")

class Constraint(int cell, int[] unknown, int remaining)

Constraint[] constraints(const Board board)
    Constraint[] result := []
    for cell := board.revealed.indices()[]
        if not board.revealed[cell] or board.numbers[cell] == 0
            continue
        unknown := [for neighbor := board.neighbors[cell][] if is_unknown(board, neighbor) then neighbor]
        if #unknown > 0
            flags := int(#[for neighbor := board.neighbors[cell][] if board.marks[neighbor] == 1 then neighbor])
            result = result.append(Constraint(int(cell), unknown, board.numbers[cell] - flags))
    return result

class Deduction()
    safe := map<int, string>()
    mines := map<int, string>()

void add_reasons(map<int, string> &reasons, const int[] cells, string reason)
    for cell := cells[]
        if not reasons.has(cell)
            .reasons.set(cell, reason)

bool has_deduction(const Deduction result)
    return result.safe.size() > 0 or result.mines.size() > 0

Deduction deduction(const Board board)
    known := constraints(board)
    result := Deduction()
    for clue := known[]
        if clue.remaining == 0
            add_reasons(&result.safe, clue.unknown, "single {cell_text(board, clue.cell)}")
    if has_deduction(result)
        return result
    for clue := known[]
        if clue.remaining == int(#clue.unknown)
            add_reasons(&result.mines, clue.unknown, "single {cell_text(board, clue.cell)}")
    if has_deduction(result)
        return result
    for left := known[]
        for right := known[]
            if #left.unknown >= #right.unknown
                continue
            contained := true
            for cell := left.unknown[]
                if not includes(right.unknown, cell)
                    contained = false
                    break
            if not contained
                continue
            difference := [for cell := right.unknown[] if not includes(left.unknown, cell) then cell]
            needed := right.remaining - left.remaining
            reason := "subset {cell_text(board, left.cell)} {cell_text(board, right.cell)}"
            if needed == 0
                add_reasons(&result.safe, difference, reason)
            elif needed == int(#difference)
                add_reasons(&result.mines, difference, reason)
    if not has_deduction(result) and board.state == "playing" and remaining_mines(board) == 0
        add_reasons(&result.safe, unknown_cells(board), "count")
    return result

class AutoResult()
    rounds := 0
    flagged := 0
    opened := 0

AutoResult auto_play(Board &board, string safety)
    totals := AutoResult()
    while board.state == "playing"
        found := deduction(board)
        if not has_deduction(found)
            break
        totals.rounds += 1
        for cell := found.safe.keys().sorted()[]
            if not board.revealed[cell]
                board.moves = board.moves.append(Move("auto-reveal", cell))
                totals.opened += reveal_cell(&board, cell, safety)
                win_check(&board)
                if finished(board)
                    break
        if finished(board)
            break
        for cell := found.mines.keys().sorted()[]
            if is_unknown(board, cell)
                board.marks[cell] = 1
                totals.flagged += 1
                board.moves = board.moves.append(Move("auto-flag", cell))
    return totals

class Component(int[] cells, int[] mine_counts, int configurations, int minimum, int maximum)
class Frontier(bool[] cells, Component[] components)

class Search(int[] required, int[] left, int[][] touches, int[] order)
    sums := array(#required, fill = 0)
    values := array(#touches, fill = 0)
    mine_counts := array(#touches, fill = 0)
    configurations := 0
    minimum := 0
    maximum := 0

void search_configs(Search &search, int depth)
    if depth == int(#search.order)
        search.configurations += 1
        search.mine_counts += search.values
        int total := search.values.sum()
        if search.configurations == 1
            search.minimum = total
            search.maximum = total
        else
            search.minimum = math.min(search.minimum, total)
            search.maximum = math.max(search.maximum, total)
        return
    cell := search.order[depth]
    affected := search.touches[cell]
    for index := affected[]
        search.left[index] -= 1
    for: 0 <= value <= 1
        valid := true
        for index := affected[]
            search.sums[index] += value
            int needed := search.required[index] - search.sums[index]
            if needed < 0 or needed > search.left[index]
                valid = false
        if valid
            search.values[cell] = value
            search_configs(&search, depth + 1)
        for index := affected[]
            search.sums[index] -= value
    for index := affected[]
        search.left[index] += 1

Component count_component(const int[] cells, const Constraint[] known)
    int[][] touches := array(#cells, fill = [])
    for index := known.indices()[]
        for cell := known[index].unknown[]
            local_index := position_of(cells, cell)
            touches[local_index] = touches[local_index].append(int(index))
    degrees := [for adjacent := touches[] then int(#adjacent)]
    width := int(#cells) + 1
    largest := degrees.max()
    keys := [for index := degrees.indices()[] then (largest - degrees[index]) * width + int(index)]
    order := keys.sorted() % width
    required := [for clue := known[] then clue.remaining]
    left := [for clue := known[] then int(#clue.unknown)]
    search := Search(required, left, touches, order)
    possible := true
    for index := known.indices()[]
        if required[index] < 0 or required[index] > left[index]
            possible = false
    if possible
        search_configs(&search, 0)
    return Component(cells, search.mine_counts, search.configurations, search.minimum, search.maximum)

Frontier frontier(const Board board, target := -1)
    known := constraints(board)
    int[][] members := array(#board.revealed, fill = [])
    cells := array(#board.revealed, fill = false)
    for index := known.indices()[]
        for cell := known[index].unknown[]
            cells[cell] = true
            members[cell] = members[cell].append(int(index))
    seen := array(#cells, fill = false)
    Component[] components := []
    for start := cells.indices()[]
        if not cells[start] or seen[start]
            continue
        queue := [int(start)]
        seen[start] = true
        used := array(#known, fill = false)
        nat head := 0
        while head < #queue
            cell := queue[head]
            head += 1
            for index := members[cell][]
                if used[index]
                    continue
                used[index] = true
                for neighbor := known[index].unknown[]
                    if not seen[neighbor]
                        seen[neighbor] = true
                        queue = queue.append(neighbor)
        if target < 0 or includes(queue, target)
            selected := [for index := known.indices()[] if used[index] then known[index]]
            components = components.append(count_component(queue.sorted(), selected))
    return Frontier(cells, components)

int guess_cell(const Board board)
    boundary := frontier(board)
    unknown := unknown_cells(board)
    numerators := array(#board.revealed, fill = -1)
    denominators := array(#board.revealed, fill = 1)
    for component := boundary.components[]
        if component.configurations > 0
            for index := component.cells.indices()[]
                cell := component.cells[index]
                numerators[cell] = component.mine_counts[index]
                denominators[cell] = component.configurations
    remainder := math.max(remaining_mines(board), 0)
    for cell := unknown[]
        if not boundary.cells[cell]
            numerators[cell] = remainder
            denominators[cell] = int(#unknown)
    chosen := -1
    best_numerator := 0
    best_denominator := 1
    for cell := unknown[]
        if numerators[cell] >= 0 and (chosen < 0 or numerators[cell] * best_denominator < best_numerator * denominators[cell])
            chosen = cell
            best_numerator = numerators[cell]
            best_denominator = denominators[cell]
    return chosen

class SolveResult(int guesses, AutoResult totals)

SolveResult solve_play(Board &board, string safety)
    guesses := 0
    totals := AutoResult()
    while true
        automatic := auto_play(&board, safety)
        totals.rounds += automatic.rounds
        totals.flagged += automatic.flagged
        totals.opened += automatic.opened
        if finished(board)
            break
        cell := guess_cell(board)
        if cell < 0
            break
        guesses += 1
        board.moves = board.moves.append(Move("guess", cell))
        totals.opened += reveal_cell(&board, cell, safety)
        win_check(&board)
        if finished(board)
            break
    return SolveResult(guesses, totals)

void board_info(const Board board)
    blank := [for cell := board.mines.indices()[] then not board.mines[cell] and board.numbers[cell] == 0]
    seen := array(#blank, fill = false)
    covered := array(#blank, fill = false)
    openings := 0
    largest := 0
    for start := blank.indices()[]
        if not blank[start] or seen[start]
            continue
        openings += 1
        queue := [int(start)]
        seen[start] = true
        area := array(#blank, fill = false)
        nat head := 0
        while head < #queue
            cell := queue[head]
            head += 1
            area[cell] = true
            for neighbor := board.neighbors[cell][]
                area[neighbor] = true
                if blank[neighbor] and not seen[neighbor]
                    seen[neighbor] = true
                    queue = queue.append(neighbor)
        size := int(#[for member := area[] if member then member])
        largest = math.max(largest, size)
        for cell := area.indices()[]
            covered[cell] = covered[cell] or area[cell]
    isolated := int(#[for cell := covered.indices()[] if not covered[cell] and not board.mines[cell] then cell])
    emit("3bv {openings + isolated} openings {openings} largest {largest} mines {board.mine_count} safe {safe_count(board)}")

void replay(const Board board, int count, string safety)
    emit("replay {count}/{#board.moves}")
    copy := board
    reset_board(&copy)
    for: 0 <= index < count
        move := board.moves[index]
        copy.moves = copy.moves.append(move)
        if index_of(["reveal", "auto-reveal", "guess"], move.kind) >= 0
            reveal_cell(&copy, move.cell, safety)
        elif move.kind == "chord"
            chord_cells(&copy, move.cell, safety)
        elif move.kind == "flag" or move.kind == "auto-flag"
            copy.marks[move.cell] = 1
        elif move.kind == "unflag"
            copy.marks[move.cell] = 0
        else
            copy.marks[move.cell] = if copy.marks[move.cell] == 2 then 0 else 2
        win_check(&copy)
    show_board(copy)

class Statistics()
    played := 0
    wins := 0
    losses := 0
    streak := 0
    best := 0
    int | none fastest := none

void update_stats(Statistics &stats, const Board board)
    stats.played += 1
    if board.state == "won"
        stats.wins += 1
        stats.streak += 1
        stats.best = math.max(stats.best, stats.streak)
        moves := int(#board.moves)
        match stats.fastest
            int previous
                stats.fastest = math.min(previous, moves)
            none
                stats.fastest = moves
    else
        stats.losses += 1
        stats.streak = 0

void print_stats(const Statistics stats)
    rate := if stats.played == 0 then "-" else "{100 * stats.wins / stats.played}%"
    fastest := "-"
    match stats.fastest
        int moves
            fastest = "{moves}"
        none
            fastest = "-"
    emit("stats played {stats.played} won {stats.wins} lost {stats.losses} rate {rate} streak {stats.streak} best {stats.best} fastest {fastest}")

class Program()
    safety := "block"
    Board | none board := none
    stats := Statistics()

Board | error require_board(const Program program)
    match program.board
        Board found
            return found
        none
            return error("no game")

void | error layout_command(Program &program, int width, int height, const string[] rows)
    for index := rows.indices()[]
        valid := #rows[index] == nat(width)
        for point := rows[index].codepoints()[]
            if point != 42 and point != 46
                valid = false
        if not valid
            return error("bad row {index + 1}")
    flat := rows.join("")
    mines := [for point := flat.codepoints()[] then point == 42]
    count := int(#[for mine := mines[] if mine then mine])
    if count == 0 or count == width * height
        return error("bad mine count {count}")
    board := new_board(width, height, count, 0)
    board.placed = true
    board.state = "playing"
    board.mines = mines
    compute_numbers(&board)
    program.board = board
    emit("layout {size_text(board)} mines {count}")
    return void

void print_hint(const Board board)
    found := deduction(board)
    reasons := found.safe
    kind := "safe"
    if reasons.size() == 0
        reasons = found.mines
        kind = "mine"
    if reasons.size() == 0
        emit("hint none")
        return
    cell := reasons.keys().sorted()[0]
    match reasons.get(cell)
        string reason
            emit("hint {kind} {cell_text(board, cell)} by {reason}")
        none
            return

void print_probability(const Board board, int cell)
    boundary := frontier(board, cell)
    if not boundary.cells[cell]
        emit("prob {cell_text(board, cell)} unconstrained")
        return
    for component := boundary.components[]
        index := position_of(component.cells, cell)
        if index < 0
            continue
        if component.configurations == 0
            emit("prob {cell_text(board, cell)} inconsistent")
        else
            emit("prob {cell_text(board, cell)} {fraction(component.mine_counts[index], component.configurations)} size {#component.cells} configs {component.configurations}")
        return

void print_frontier(const Board board)
    boundary := frontier(board)
    cells := int(#[for member := boundary.cells[] if member then member])
    emit("frontier {cells} components {#boundary.components}")
    for component := boundary.components[]
        text := "component {cell_text(board, component.cells[0])} size {#component.cells}"
        if component.configurations == 0
            emit(text + " inconsistent")
        else
            emit(text + " configs {component.configurations} min {component.minimum} max {component.maximum}")

void | error command(Program &program, const string[] tokens)
    commands := ["NEW", "PRESET", "LAYOUT", "SAFETY", "RESTART", "REVEAL", "FLAG", "UNFLAG", "QUESTION", "CHORD", "UNDO", "SHOW", "STATUS", "CELL", "HISTORY", "REPLAY", "HINT", "AUTO", "ANALYZE", "PROB", "FRONTIER", "SOLVE", "BOARDINFO", "STATS"]
    arities := [4, 2, 2, 1, 0, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 0, 0, 0, 2, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    op := tokens[0]
    operation := index_of(commands, op)
    if operation < 0
        return error("unknown command " + op)
    if int(#tokens) != arities[operation] + 1
        return error("bad arguments")
    int[] values := []
    mode := ""
    if op == "PRESET"
        preset := index_of(["beginner", "intermediate", "expert"], tokens[1])
        if preset < 0
            return error("bad arguments")
        seed := try number_word(tokens[2])
        int[][] settings := [[9, 9, 10], [16, 16, 40], [30, 16, 99]]
        values = settings[preset].append(seed)
    elif op == "SAFETY"
        mode = tokens[1]
        if index_of(["block", "cell", "none"], mode) < 0
            return error("bad arguments")
    else
        for token := tokens[1:][]
            value := try number_word(token)
            values = values.append(value)
    if op == "NEW" or op == "PRESET"
        width := values[0]
        height := values[1]
        mines := values[2]
        seed := values[3]
        if width < 1 or width > 30 or height < 1 or height > 30 or mines < 1 or mines > width * height - 9 or seed < 1 or seed > 2147483646
            return error("bad value")
        created := new_board(width, height, mines, seed)
        program.board = created
        emit("new {size_text(created)} mines {mines}")
        return void
    if op == "HISTORY" and values[0] == 0
        return error("bad value")
    if op == "SAFETY"
        program.safety = mode
        emit("safety " + mode)
        return void
    if op == "STATS"
        print_stats(program.stats)
        return void
    board := try require_board(program)
    cell := -1
    if index_of(["REVEAL", "FLAG", "UNFLAG", "QUESTION", "CHORD", "CELL", "PROB"], op) >= 0
        if values[0] >= board.width or values[1] >= board.height
            return error("out of range")
        cell = values[0] + board.width * values[1]
    if index_of(["REVEAL", "FLAG", "UNFLAG", "QUESTION", "CHORD", "UNDO", "HINT", "AUTO", "ANALYZE", "PROB", "FRONTIER", "SOLVE"], op) >= 0 and finished(board)
        return error("game over")
    if (op == "ANALYZE" or op == "BOARDINFO") and not board.placed
        return error("not started")
    undo_index := index_of(["REVEAL", "FLAG", "UNFLAG", "QUESTION", "CHORD", "AUTO", "SOLVE"], op)
    undo_name := ""
    if undo_index >= 0
        names := ["reveal", "flag", "unflag", "question", "chord", "auto", "solve"]
        undo_name = names[undo_index]
    before := UndoRecord(undo_name, board.revealed, board.marks, board.moves)
    previous_moves := int(#board.moves)
    if op == "RESTART"
        reset_board(&board)
        emit("restart {size_text(board)} mines {board.mine_count}")
    elif index_of(["REVEAL", "FLAG", "UNFLAG", "QUESTION", "PROB"], op) >= 0
        if board.revealed[cell]
            return error("already revealed")
        if (op == "REVEAL" or op == "PROB") and board.marks[cell] == 1
            return error("flagged")
        if op == "FLAG" and board.marks[cell] == 1
            return error("already flagged")
        if op == "UNFLAG" and board.marks[cell] != 1
            return error("not flagged")
        if op == "REVEAL"
            board.moves = board.moves.append(Move("reveal", cell))
            opened := reveal_cell(&board, cell, program.safety)
            if board.state != "lost"
                emit("revealed {opened}")
                win_check(&board)
            finish_output(board)
        elif op == "FLAG"
            board.marks[cell] = 1
            board.moves = board.moves.append(Move("flag", cell))
            emit("flagged {cell_text(board, cell)} left {remaining_mines(board)}")
        elif op == "UNFLAG"
            board.marks[cell] = 0
            board.moves = board.moves.append(Move("unflag", cell))
            emit("unflagged {cell_text(board, cell)} left {remaining_mines(board)}")
        elif op == "QUESTION"
            marked := board.marks[cell] != 2
            board.marks[cell] = if marked then 2 else 0
            board.moves = board.moves.append(Move("question", cell))
            verb := if marked then "questioned" else "unmarked"
            emit("{verb} {cell_text(board, cell)} left {remaining_mines(board)}")
        else
            print_probability(board, cell)
    elif op == "CHORD"
        if not board.revealed[cell]
            return error("not revealed")
        int number := board.numbers[cell]
        if number == 0
            return error("no number")
        flags := int(#[for neighbor := board.neighbors[cell][] if board.marks[neighbor] == 1 then neighbor])
        if flags != number
            return error("flags {flags} of {number}")
        if #[for neighbor := board.neighbors[cell][] if is_unknown(board, neighbor) then neighbor] == 0
            return error("nothing to reveal")
        board.moves = board.moves.append(Move("chord", cell))
        opened := chord_cells(&board, cell, program.safety)
        if board.state != "lost"
            emit("chorded {opened}")
            win_check(&board)
        finish_output(board)
    elif op == "UNDO"
        if #board.undos == 0
            return error("nothing to undo")
        saved := board.undos[-1]
        board.undos = board.undos[0:<int(#board.undos) - 1]
        board.revealed = saved.revealed
        board.marks = saved.marks
        board.moves = saved.moves
        emit("undo {saved.kind} moves {#board.moves}")
    elif op == "SHOW"
        show_board(board)
    elif op == "STATUS"
        emit("status {board.state} left {remaining_mines(board)} moves {#board.moves} revealed {revealed_count(board)}/{safe_count(board)}")
    elif op == "CELL"
        if board.revealed[cell]
            flags := int(#[for neighbor := board.neighbors[cell][] if board.marks[neighbor] == 1 then neighbor])
            unknown := int(#[for neighbor := board.neighbors[cell][] if is_unknown(board, neighbor) then neighbor])
            emit("cell {cell_text(board, cell)} number {board.numbers[cell]} flags {flags} unknown {unknown}")
        else
            names := ["none", "flag", "question"]
            open := int(#[for neighbor := board.neighbors[cell][] if board.revealed[neighbor] then neighbor])
            emit("cell {cell_text(board, cell)} hidden mark {names[board.marks[cell]]} open {open}")
    elif op == "HISTORY"
        emit("history {#board.moves}")
        start := math.max(0, int(#board.moves) - values[0])
        for: start <= index < int(#board.moves)
            move := board.moves[index]
            emit("{index + 1} {move.kind} {cell_text(board, move.cell)}")
    elif op == "REPLAY"
        if values[0] > int(#board.moves)
            return error("no move {values[0]}")
        replay(board, values[0], program.safety)
    elif op == "HINT"
        print_hint(board)
    elif op == "AUTO"
        result := auto_play(&board, program.safety)
        emit("auto rounds {result.rounds} flagged {result.flagged} revealed {result.opened}")
        finish_output(board)
    elif op == "ANALYZE"
        copy := board
        result := auto_play(&copy, program.safety)
        if copy.state == "lost"
            emit("analyze boom {cell_text(copy, copy.exploded)} rounds {result.rounds}")
        elif copy.state == "won"
            emit("analyze clear rounds {result.rounds}")
        else
            emit("analyze stuck rounds {result.rounds} revealed {revealed_count(copy)}/{safe_count(copy)}")
    elif op == "FRONTIER"
        print_frontier(board)
    elif op == "SOLVE"
        result := solve_play(&board, program.safety)
        emit("solve guesses {result.guesses} rounds {result.totals.rounds} flagged {result.totals.flagged} revealed {result.totals.opened}")
        finish_output(board)
    elif op == "BOARDINFO"
        board_info(board)
    if undo_index >= 0 and int(#board.moves) > previous_moves
        board.undos = board.undos.append(before)
        if finished(board)
            update_stats(&program.stats, board)
    program.board = board
    return void
